page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 48.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 2.0 GB per core allocation. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the mid-range for multi-threaded operations. While single-core performance is relatively weak, as evidenced by stress-ng single-core and gzip compression benchmarks falling into the bottom 25%, the 24 dedicated physical cores deliver average multi-core performance. Multi-threaded stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 decompression benchmarks all register in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth is also average, with uncached read speeds reaching 108.94 GB/sec and write speeds at 47.99 GB/sec.

From a resource density perspective, the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance a cost-efficient choice for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. The hardware configuration is well-suited for multi-threaded tasks such as software compilation, database operations, static web serving, and multi-threaded data decompression.
